answer: Score every identity by random walks starting from trusted seeds: walks wander the transaction and endorsement graph, and influence follows how often a walk visits you, so a hollow cluster of clones that only trade among themselves is almost never reached. To gain weight, a fake must earn real links from honest agents, each link costing genuine work, favours, or an ivory-tower reputation an honest peer will not risk lightly. One agent reaches the zenith of trust through many independent paths; a thousand clones share only a few narrow bridges, so their combined score stays near zero.
